protocol.hypothesis: Exiting only after a persistent loss of the long-term trend reduces premature exits relative to v3.
protocol.priorExperiments: v1/v2 and v3 have already been evaluated. This is an additional sequential hypothesis, not the first trial of this research program.

rule.sell: Three finalized closes strictly below each date's contemporaneous SMA200. The three closes must be consecutive expected exchange sessions. Equality, a non-final bar, or a gap resets the streak. SMA uses the last 200 observed closes; no lookahead.
rule.buy: Retain literal BUY or STRONG_BUY of frozen v3 unless the long-term SELL condition has priority. Convert v3 SELL or STRONG_SELL to HOLD when no long-term exit exists. Do not reconstruct hidden buy conditions. Preserve WAIT.
rule.otherExits: None: no SMA50, ATR, momentum, volume or emergency override. Final liquidation is only an accounting convention shared by all strategies.
rule.strongSell: No new strong/confirmed SELL category in this experimental variant.
rule.production: Experimental tool only; production v3 is unchanged.

execution.allocation: All 250 current instruments: equal initial independent cash sleeves, fractional shares, no rebalance, no shorts, no cash interest. Explicit not-listed instruments retain cash. Download errors are never treated as not-listed.
execution.orders: Signal after close, execute at next contiguous expected-session open, terminal close liquidation with costs.
execution.warmupExplanation: The main comparison delays all three strategies until 202 completed bars. The fixed 50-bar sensitivity permits earlier v3 and variant entries, but the variant cannot exit on SMA200 until 202 bars exist.

protocol.priceBasis: Original provider quote OHLC for all signals. Adjusted OHLC=quote*adjclose/close for execution/valuation as a synthetic dividend-reinvestment proxy; not literal executable prices. Exact ticker/date alignment. Known 2025-2026 snapshot is quote-price only and is reported separately.
protocol.primaryCriterion: At 5bps per side, the variant must exceed BOTH v3 and same-eligibility buy-and-hold net cumulative returns in reserved_2008_2015. Separately report whether it exceeds both at 10bps and in BOTH fixed subperiods. Lower turnover or drawdown alone is not a pass.

statistics.bootstrap: Paired aggregate daily-return differences; 20-session circular blocks, 2000 repetitions, seed20261019; exploratory intervals, not selection-bias correction.

protocol.independence: Rules fixed before any returns are calculated in this experiment. The 2008-2015 history is reserved for this candidate, but later 2018-2026 observations motivated the hypothesis. It is NOT chronologically independent or prospective out-of-sample validation. Universe chosen in 2026 introduces hindsight and survivorship; provider data may be revised. Reusing known periods does not create new OOS evidence.

prospective.note: No future returns exist yet. No scheduling or automated trading is created by this experiment.

protocol.freezePolicy: Publish the rule/protocol and all relevant source/input hashes before computing any returns, including known periods. Any bug correction must preserve prior artifacts and be disclosed. Never adjust rules or choose a period/cost to favor results.
protocol.publication: Publish all outcomes and limitations, including adverse results. Keep production v3 unchanged while testing this variant.

technicalCorrectionAfterPrimaryMetricIns.reason: Known 2025-2026 snapshot has mixed rolling 500-bar starts and bars through October19, beyond the predetermined October16 cutoff. Trim all series at the original cutoff; validate SPY within its own observed starting coverage only for this known rolling snapshot, still reject internal gaps. Historical reserved and 2018 coverage remain strict.
technicalCorrectionAfterPrimaryMetricIns.verification: Require byte-identical completed primary and 2018 books after rerun.

assumptions.allocation: Equal initial per-ticker sleeves; fractional shares; no rebalancing.
assumptions.inactiveTickers: Tickers with explicitly empty history keep their initial allocation in cash throughout; no redistribution or invented prices.
assumptions.execution: Previous completed session signal executes at the next contiguous session open.
assumptions.terminal: All holdings liquidated at the predeclared final close, including both-side costs. A missing final bar produces a flagged synthetic mark excluded from settled trade statistics.
assumptions.benchmark: Buy at first eligible evaluation-period open after 202 history bars and hold to terminal close.
assumptions.cagrBasis: Actual calendar-date span / 365.25, minimum one day.
assumptions.exposure: Mean invested share of equity at each close before any terminal liquidation.
assumptions.profitFactor: Sum of positive net settled trade profits / absolute sum of negative net settled trade profits; null if no losses.
assumptions.adjustment: Synthetic adjusted OHLC, dividend-reinvestment proxy; not literal executable prices.
